evidence.title: SYNTHETIC pressurization input schema
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK RULE: stair pressurization calculation requires building height, stair/zone geometry, leakage/opening data, target pressure criterion, and fan/airflow design inputs. Height alone is insufficient.

evidence.title: SYNTHETIC sprinkler input schema
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK RULE: sprinkler hydraulic calculation requires a defined hazard/design basis plus pipe network geometry, pipe sizes/lengths, discharge/device data and supply conditions. Floor area alone is insufficient.

evidence.title: SYNTHETIC water network input schema
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK RULE: hydraulic network calculation requires topology and pipe lengths/diameters plus demand/supply conditions. A network without pipe lengths cannot produce a final pressure-loss result.

evidence.title: SYNTHETIC fire water input schema
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK RULE: fire-water demand cannot be finalized from floor area alone; the benchmark requires occupancy/use and hazard/design classification plus system/supply assumptions.
